value.rationale: An exact all-dimensional third directional-width moment formula distinguishes degree-equivalent trees sharing combinatorial cube type, volume, means and second moments. The strict negative three-edge-path coefficient detects degree mixing beyond the first two moments, and an explicit smallest-scale witness demonstrates the phenomenon. Motivated structural inverse-moment invariant rather than a routine specialized computation.
